review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.797 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -2.7 sets. It counts toward Volleyball scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections (it's how teams with no standings on the routes build a record of their own).

Across 738 graded Volleyball games the algo now scales scoring ×0.965 and gives home teams +0.2 sets. Team corrections so far: Seminoles attack ×0.960, defense ×0.960 (6 games); Tigers attack ×0.960, defense ×1.040 (6 games).
